concerns.text: FR-001 specifies the unified schema includes columns for material type, process parameters, residual stress, and fatigue life cycles, but omits material‑property columns (e.g., yield strength, hardness) required for Feature Set C as described in the idea and FR‑004.

FR-003 states the residual‑stress proxy is used ONLY for Feature Set C construction, whereas the original idea allows the proxy to be used in stress‑mediated models (Feature Set B) when measured stress is missing. This redefines the analysis plan and limits the ability to assess predictive value of stress‑mediated features, constituting a drift from the research question.
